mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong supply-side activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,150,000 units, it signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1150.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decelerating labor market (PAYEMS growth rate below 0.5%) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE increase > 0.2pp) signals economic weakness, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE rise > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% for two consecutive quarters), a deceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate falling below 2.0%) signals an impending slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate falls below 2.0%.
